brand.name: AI Image Prompts
brand.oneLineStory: A curated workshop for image-makers: prompts as craft, not spam.

do: Use specific language and concrete nouns.
Treat prompts as a creative practice (not 'AI hype').

designIntent.northStar: A bold, tactile editorial interface with high contrast and a single sharp accent.

rules: Use the display face sparingly for hero headings and section titles.
Body text stays highly readable; never compress line-height below 1.4.
Prefer sentence-case headings; avoid ALL CAPS unless used as a small label.

accessibility.notes: Accent should be used as a highlight, not as a body-text color.

preferred: soft radial glow behind hero content
thin editorial grid lines at low opacity

principles: One signature motion per page (entrance rhythm), not many micro-animations.
Use easing that feels intentional (no bouncy defaults).

buttons.style: high-contrast, tactile hover, clear focus ring

cards.style: editorial slabs with subtle border + depth, avoid 'template card' look
cards.detail: use a thin top rule or corner mark to create identity

seo.metaDescriptionStyle: plainspoken, concrete, under 155 chars when possible
